steps.title: Start in the lobby
steps.text: Sign in to the Epic account where you want the Outfit. From the lobby, find the passes area. The wording and layout may vary with the current game interface.
steps.hint: Capture the lobby with the Passes entry visible. Highlight that entry in your own screenshot.

steps.title: Browse the available passes
steps.text: If the Passes area opens on Battle Pass, use the Passes & FN Crew entry near the bottom of that screen to browse other passes. The Battle Pass is separate from the Teto Music Mini-Pass.
steps.hint: Capture the Battle Pass overview with the Passes & FN Crew entry visible.

steps.title: Open the Teto Music Pass
steps.text: Select the TWINDRILL DIVA Music Mini-Pass, then choose Get Music Pass to review the standalone offer. Epic announced a 1,000 V-Bucks price and inclusion with an active Crew subscription. Check the next confirmation screen and your existing access before purchasing.
steps.hint: Capture the Teto Music Pass with Get Music Pass visible, or its following access confirmation.

steps.title: Claim and equip Teto
steps.text: Pass access immediately unlocks the base Kasane Teto Outfit. The reward screen can show Claimed and offer an Equip button; you can also select the owned Outfit in your Locker. This does not complete the remaining reward progression.
steps.hint: Capture the Teto reward marked Claimed with Equip available, or the owned Outfit in the Locker.

steps.title: Earn the reactive style
steps.text: The music-reactive option is the final-tier reward. Check the live pass requirements, then inspect the Outfit’s style settings after earning it. This is an additional style, not a second unrelated character.
steps.hint: Capture the final reactive-style reward or its earned style option. Label whether your screenshot shows a preview or an owned reward.

milestones: Epic published the Teto Music Mini-Pass announcement on November 11, 2026. The announcement is the source for the pass price, Outfit grant and headline rewards.
The announced pass launch date was November 12, 2026. The official French press release described the pass as available that day. This guide is not a live server-status check.

Epic separately scheduled Teto and Cap’n Hatsune Miku’s appearance at Friendship Villa for November 15. As of this guide’s November 14 review, this is a scheduled event, not a personally verified visit.
profileViews: Official Fortnite promotional art shows the game adaptation. Consult actual game previews for the Outfit and its earned styles.
Teto’s character identity and reference designs predate Fortnite. A character illustration is not proof that every pictured costume is obtainable in the game.
UTAU, Synthesizer V and VOICEPEAK refer to voice products associated with Teto. A product image or music illustration does not mean its contents are included in Fortnite.
